scope: Linux installation prefix (//:hirsel-toolchain): every shipped file is classified by `files`. Crate inventories are link inputs (Rust and bundled C/assembly, before dead-code elimination) of the compiler and the runtime archive; build scripts and proc-macro executables are build tools, not linked libraries. Native libraries are the llvm-23.lock pins, with the notices of the source tree they are built from and of the C and C++ runtimes they link statically. Upstream library notices can conservatively cover other targets.

hirsel.contents: the compiler, launcher and embedded platform host

runtime/*/*/libhirsel_core_rt.a.contents: the runtime archive a program links, per target

link/kit/*-linux-gnu/*.contents: glibc 2.28 startup objects and link-only stubs, LLVM CRT and libunwind

link/kit/aarch64-apple-darwin/*.tbd.contents: link-only text stubs generated from Hirsel's Darwin symbol allowlists

core-packages/*.contents: the core and std package images and the Store source archive

libexec/hirsel/pin_reader.contents: the Hirsel offline pin reader, linked with the shipped runtime archive

libexec/hirsel/store_tool.contents: the Hirsel store backup and restore tool, linked with the shipped runtime archive

libexec/hirsel/.hirsel-debug/*.debug.contents: detached debug information for the platform executables

hirsel.profdata.contents: the profile a PGO build of the compiler used (PGO builds only)

engine_llvm.static_note: Linked by clang and lld in manylinux_2_28 against AlmaLinux's glibc and GCC Toolset 14. These notices cover the startup objects and the libgcc, libstdc++ and libc_nonshared parts linked into the library.

static_lld.static_note: A static PIE built in manylinux_2_28. It includes AlmaLinux's static glibc and GCC Toolset 14 libstdc++, libgcc and libgcc_eh.

darwin_llvm.static_note: A Mac host's compiler LLVM library and bin/ld.lld, built by tools/native-toolchain/build-libllvm-darwin with the Xcode command line tools against the macOS SDK. They load libSystem, libc++ and libz from the system and link no third-party runtime statically.

native_text_rule: From the locked source archive (source_url, source_sha256): each component's licenses, every file under its source_dirs named LICENSE/COPYING/COPYRIGHT/NOTICE, and every text file there that contains 'copyright', outside test, unittests, docs and utils directories.

glibc.source: Corresponding source: https://vault.almalinux.org/8.10/BaseOS/Source/Packages/glibc-2.28-251.el8_10.53.src.rpm. See tools/native-toolchain/build-static-lld and build-libllvm for rebuilding and relinking the components.

gcc.source: Corresponding source: https://vault.almalinux.org/8.10/AppStream/Source/Packages/gcc-toolset-14-gcc-14.2.1-11.el8_10.src.rpm. The GCC Runtime Library Exception applies.

link-kit-glibc.source: Corresponding source: https://archive.debian.org/debian/pool/main/g/glibc/glibc_2.28-10+deb10u1.dsc. tools/buck2/native-toolchain/link_kit.py derives the link-only stubs from the pinned release and copies its startup objects and libc_nonshared archive.

link-kit-llvm.source: The locked LLVM source archive supplies the CRT objects and the LLVM unwinder selected by the kit’s libgcc_s.so linker script. The Apache 2.0 license with LLVM exceptions and the upstream alternatives appear in the shipped texts.

external.component: Host loader, libc, libm, libdl, libpthread, librt, libgcc_s, libstdc++ and libz
external.status: System dependencies, not copied into the installation.
System dependencies of Darwin programs. The bundle ships only Hirsel-generated link stubs.
